expression_name_cn: 结尾处若有所思的沉默
style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: open but slightly narrowed, focused on something off-camera at a far middle-distance — not unfocused like '无语', but pointed at an idea rather than a person, with a faint reflective wetness at the lower lid (not tears, just thinking-moisture)
expression_signature.brows: slightly drawn together but not in anger — in concentration, the inner ends lifted very slightly as if asking himself a question
expression_signature.mouth: closed, lips together, lower lip a fraction fuller than usual — the posture of a man chewing on an unspoken word
expression_signature.head: tilted slightly to the right by 5 degrees, chin slightly up (more upright than his default collapse — he has straightened up to think)
expression_signature.overall_impression: the face of a man who has just heard his own life named — used only on Page 18 (the 'naming' cross-spread), the emotional climax of the whole story

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_for_this_moment: going-out alt: same loose grey cotton t-shirt but now with a dark grey zip-up hoodie over it, hood down — he is dressed to go to a matchmaking meeting, not pajama-home anymore
inherit_from_base.default_posture_override: upright, shoulders squared for the first time in the story, neck no longer forward

micro_motion.static: seated at a small table across from MC 鲁迅, hands lightly clasped together on the table edge, knuckles not white, just held
micro_motion.subtle_motion: a slow single swallow before he speaks; thumbs tapping once against each other; gaze finally lifting from the table to meet the listener's eyes in the final beat
transition_to: (终点，无下一表情 — 这是结尾帧)

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: single overhead warm light source casting a soft pool on the table between two figures, the rest of the room in cool ambient shadow — two islands of warmth separated by darkness
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: any daylight or window light — this is an interior night meeting, the artificial light is the point
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.narrative_pairing: cross-spread Page 18, the second his hand grips MC 鲁迅's hand
